1214 PM EDT Sun Oct 11 2026

20 kt. Waves 1 to 2 ft. Showers with a chance of tstms. 
.MON...N winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt... diminishing to
10 kt late. Waves 2 ft. Showers.
.MON NIGHT...NW winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.TUE...SW winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves flat...building to 2 ft in the
afternoon. 
.TUE NIGHT...SW winds 10 to 15 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.WED...SW winds 5 to 10 kt...becoming N 10 to 15 kt after midnight.
Waves 1 to 2 ft.

of showers after midnight.  

Winds and waves higher and visibilities lower in and near tstms.
